description: Three full-body sessions a week. Every muscle is trained three times, so you practise each lift often while recovering between sessions. The best place to start in a gym.

blockTypes.superset: Two exercises back to back, no rest between.

weeks.title: Settle in
weeks.focus: Stop each set about 3 reps before failure. Learn the lifts and find your starting weights.

exercises.name: Barbell Squat
exercises.instructions: Bar on your upper back, brace, sit down between your hips. Drive up with your chest tall.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press - Medium Grip
exercises.instructions: Shoulder blades pinched, feet planted. Lower to mid-chest and press back over your shoulders.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Rows
exercises.instructions: Sit tall. Row the handle to your belly, pinch your shoulder blades, then let them stretch forward.

exercises.name: Side Lateral Raise
exercises.instructions: Slight lean forward. Lift your elbows out to shoulder height, pour the dumbbells like a jug.

blocks.name: Triceps Pushdown - Rope Attachment + Barbell Curl

exercises.name: Triceps Pushdown - Rope Attachment
exercises.instructions: Elbows pinned to your ribs. Push down and spread the rope, squeeze, lower slowly.

exercises.name: Barbell Curl
exercises.instructions: Elbows pinned to your sides. Curl up, squeeze, then lower for two seconds.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.instructions: Forearms down, body in one straight line. Squeeze glutes and abs. Stop when your hips sag.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.instructions: Soft knees, push your hips back, bar close to your legs. Lower until your hamstrings stretch, then drive forward.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.instructions: Brace your abs, press the weights straight up until your arms are almost straight.

exercises.name: Wide-Grip Lat Pulldown
exercises.instructions: Pull the bar to your upper chest, driving your elbows down. Lean back slightly, no swinging.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.instructions: Feet shoulder-width, lower until your knees reach 90° or more without your lower back rounding.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.instructions: Bench at 30°. Elbows about 45° from your ribs, press up and slightly in.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raises
exercises.instructions: Rise onto your toes as high as possible, pause, then drop to a full stretch at the bottom.

exercises.name: Cable Crunch
exercises.instructions: Kneel, round your spine and bring your elbows to your thighs. Exhale hard at the bottom.

exercises.name: Hack Squat
exercises.instructions: Feet low and shoulder-width. Squat until your thighs are below parallel, drive up.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bench Press
exercises.instructions: Lower to the sides of your chest for a deep stretch, press up and in without clanking.

exercises.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
exercises.instructions: Hand on a bench. Row the dumbbell toward your hip, keeping your shoulders level.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl
exercises.instructions: Pad on your lower calves. Curl heels under you, squeeze, then return under control.

exercises.name: Cable Rear Delt Fly
exercises.instructions: Cross the cables, pull apart at shoulder height with soft elbows.

blocks.name: Cable Rope Overhead Triceps Extension + Hammer Curls

exercises.name: Cable Rope Overhead Triceps Extension
exercises.instructions: Face away from the cable, elbows by your ears. Extend your arms overhead, lower with a stretch.

exercises.name: Hammer Curls
exercises.instructions: Palms face each other. Curl up without twisting your wrists.

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raise
exercises.instructions: Hang from a bar, curl your pelvis up as you raise your knees. Avoid swinging.

weeks.title: Add reps
weeks.focus: Beat last week's reps on your main lifts, stopping about 2 reps short of failure.

weeks.title: Deload
weeks.focus: Cut sets by about 40% and stay about 4 reps short of failure. Recovering now makes the next block better.
